gutter.$description: The space a Page keeps at its inline edges in a compact region: spacing step 4. A Page whose container is 37.5 rem or wider keeps spacing step 5, and a Page without a gutter none; inside a Page this property is the gutter it keeps, so content lines up with it.

width-sm.$description: The width of a Page's column at width sm, for a form or settings: 40 rem.

width-md.$description: The width of a Page's column at width md, for reading: 60 rem.

width-lg.$description: The width of a Page's column at width lg, its default: 76 rem.

width.$description: The width of a NavigationRail: 5 rem.
The width a resizable NavigationDrawer starts at, 17.5 rem; on a resizable drawer, the width it has now.

size.$description: The width of the resized pane of Panes side by side, the supporting pane or the list, until people resize it: 22.5 rem; on Panes, the width it has now.

other-min.$description: The least width the other pane of Panes side by side keeps beside the resized one: 16 rem.

width-md.$description: The width of a side Sheet at width md, its default, for details and filters: 24 rem.

width-lg.$description: The width of a side Sheet at width lg, for content-heavy tasks: 44 rem.

width-md.$description: The width of a Dialog at width md, its default: 28 rem, never more than the window less its gutters.

width-lg.$description: The width of a Dialog at width lg: 44 rem, never more than the window less its gutters.
